answer: Locks are entered in lagoon, expire in ember, and violet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 190 aliases hence needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4956 identities would post 4559 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
